en: Dependent on a state that is not acquired by clinging and is subject to clinging, but is not a root-cause, there arises a state that is not acquired by clinging, is subject to clinging, and is a root-cause, by way of root-condition.

(Abbreviated. Nine in the case of root; nine in the case of object; six in the case of predominance … [and so on] … six in the case of repetition … [and so on] … six in the case of result … [and so on] … nine in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is not acquired by clinging and is subject to clinging, and is not a cause, there arises a state that is not acquired by clinging, is subject to clinging, and is not a cause, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. In the case of root condition, there are eighteen; in the case of object condition, nine; in the case of predominance condition, eleven ...
[and so on] ... in the case of repetition condition, six ... [and so on] ... in the case of result condition, fifteen ... [and so on] ... in the case of non-disappearance condition, eighteen.
